source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows and columns are the lattice separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_lines = set(sep_rows)
    col_lines = set(sep_cols)
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    cells = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0 >= r1: continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0 >= c1: continue
            cells.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # Most frequent non-divider color is the empty-cell background.
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in row_lines for c in range(w) if c not in col_lines]
    bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Extract all non-background marks from occupied cells, relative to cell origin.
    pattern = None
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in cells:
        marks = [(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] != bg]
        if marks:
            pattern = marks
            break
    if pattern is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in row_lines:
        out[r] = grid[r][:]
    for c in col_lines:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in cells:
        for dr,dc,color in pattern:
            if r0+dr < r1 and c0+dc < c1:
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = color
    return out
'''
